lines.hz: 明天是爷爷的生日，你准备礼物了吗？

grammar.point: Compound direction complements: verb + 出 / 回 / 进 / 起 / 过 + 来 or 去
grammar.en: A verb plus a direction word plus 来 (towards the speaker) or 去 (away from the speaker). A place object goes between the two parts.

drills.en: The puppy ran out of the room.
